atAGlance: Ốc len xào dừa is mud creeper snails in coconut sauce, usually with sweet coconut milk, herbs, and chili.
whatItIs: Ốc len xào dừa are small sea snails cooked in coconut milk with lemongrass and chili. The fun is pulling or sucking the sweet coconut broth from the shells.
howToEnjoy: Use toothpicks or the shell-sipping method the shop provides, and go slowly. The coconut broth is rich, sweet, salty, and often gently spicy.
howLocalsOrder: Order ốc len xào dừa as a shared ốc-shop plate. Ask for less chili before cooking and extra bread if you want to catch the coconut broth.
worthKnowing: This is classic southern snail-shop eating: hands-on, slow, messy, coconut-rich, and made for sharing.
goodToKnow: Contains or may contain seafood or shellfish.
travelerCaution: Contains or may contain seafood or shellfish.
